messages:
jules: Vendor Apollo notified billing — their QA load accidentally hit prod for ~4 hours; they got paused and billed heavily. Asking for a refund and a note to disable auto-pause next time.

nora: invoice id?

jules: INV-2025-4987. usage excerpt:
2025-09-02,api-gen,1,12000
2025-09-02,api-gen,1,8000
Total after retainer: $46,000. They request $28k refund.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-4987 found. Balance: $46,000. Auto-credit threshold: $7,500.

samir: Ops rec: prorate spike window (~10k) + goodwill 5k (per policy) = 15k. Require vendor attestation that keys were rotated. @icr-ops can you approve 15k?

icr-ops: Approve $15,000. Use GL 5421; memo "apollo-prod-qa-refund-sep25". Create CM and apply to invoice.

billing-bot: Created CM-2025-1333 for $15,000 and applied to INV-2025-4987. Audit note: "approved icr-ops 1799998950".

jules: Thanks — will send confirmation and request attestation. Closing.
